name: nightly-check__custom-theme-variables
text:
---
description: >-
  A single lane (ThemeLane) with two connected nodes, rendered with a
  custom "base" theme and themeVariables overriding the node background,
  border, and line colors.
config:
  theme: base
  themeVariables:
    mainBkg: '#ffe1ef'
    nodeBorder: '#225577'
    lineColor: '#118844'
  htmlLabels: false
  flowchart:
    useMaxWidth: false
---
swimlane-beta LR
  subgraph ThemeLane
    A[Themed node]
    B[Next node]
  end
  A --> B
